messages:
alex: ops ping  they want a one-click 'emergency SA' on the tenant console to rollback models. asking for minimal friction. thoughts?
meera: do not issue long-lived keys from UI. ephemeral tokens only. force approval + audit.
chris: agree. route policy question: if emergency flips routing, which project/org gets the quota hit? we need clear attribution.
sam: proposal: mint ephemeral token with claims {emergency:true, actor:uid, tenant:tid}. router should tag telemetry with original_project and emergency=true so billing and alerts work.
alex: UX: require typing tenant name, SSO+2FA, and two approvers for production tenants. show a fatal-warning modal. don't show raw key in UI except a one-time copy.
deploy-bot: policy sketch: mint_ephemeral_token ttl=600s require_approvals=2 audit_label=tenant_console_emergency
meera: also add a hard ceiling on RPS for emergency flows (org-configurable, default low). we cannot bypass absolute cost caps.
chris: telemetry: counter(emergency_activations), gauge(active_emergency_tokens), tag override_reason=emergency, and emit audit_id on every request header x-rwd-audit.
sam: router: honor requested traffic-split up to hard_ceiling. record previous split in audit log. disallow browser-only toggles that change splits; require SSO origin.
alex: rollout: feature-flag behind internal orgs, collect 2 weeks telemetry, then expand. security to threat model before rollout.
meera: +1. i'll draft the alert rules: fire if >2 activations in 1h per tenant or >8 org-wide per 24h.
chris: i'll update /tokens/mint to add emergency claim and return immutable audit_id. server will be able to revoke tokens and enforce ceilings.
sam: will mock modal copy and approver flow in figma.
alex: decision: prototype behind ff with hard caps, approval gating, audit hooks, and telemetry. i'll file a ticket and assign.
deploy-bot: created issue #6402 by alex: https://rwd/gh/6402 "tenant console emergency ephemeral token prototype"
